title: TPMS
summary: A training platform that connects course providers, instructors and students, with PDF certificates on completion.
role: Database design, the three portals and the certificate export.
description: The Training Provider Management System connects three kinds of users. Training providers create and manage courses and assign instructors. Instructors see their courses and set their availability. Students browse, enrol and download a certificate for a finished course.
It is plain PHP with MySQL and no framework: each portal has its own sign-in, and eight tables hold the users, the courses, the certificates and the links between them.
I reworked its look in 2026: one colour for each of the three areas, one shared stylesheet instead of eleven, and pages that fit a phone. The PHP behind the pages and the database are the originals.

highlights.title: Three portals, one database
highlights.text: Students, instructors and providers each sign in to their own area and see only what belongs to them.

highlights.title: Certificates as PDF
highlights.text: A student can generate a certificate of completion for any enrolled course, drawn with the TCPDF library.

highlights.title: Many instructors per course
highlights.text: Courses and instructors are linked through their own table, and each instructor keeps an availability status per course.

highlights.title: A colour for each area
highlights.text: Student pages are teal, instructor pages amber and provider pages indigo, so it is always clear where you are. The course card and the course page are written once and shared by all three.
